title: Risk to Singapore of Possible Cross-border Transmission of Ebola Outbreak in Congo
what_it_is: Risk to Singapore of Possible Cross-border Transmission of Ebola Outbreak in Congo

sections.label: Ebola spread and Singapore risk
sections.summary: Passage states no direct Singapore-DRC flights, low travel volume, Ebola spreads by bodily fluid contact, and outbreak is driven by delayed case identification and poor infection control.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: First, there are no direct flights between Singapore and the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), and travel volume between our countries is low.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Second, Ebola is primarily spread through direct contact with the bodily fluids of infected persons.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The outbreak in DRC is driven by delayed identification of cases and poor infection control practices in the community and healthcare settings.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: So, it does not spread easily in settings with strong public health practices and healthcare infrastructure, as we have in Singapore.

sections.label: Singapore monitoring and baseline measures
sections.summary: Passage states importation risk is low, Singapore monitors Ebola and other pathogens, uses electronic health declarations, and will adjust baseline measures if the situation changes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: The immediate risk of importation to Singapore is low, as I mentioned in my main reply, since there are no direct flights and the travel volume between our two countries is low.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: But we are constantly monitoring the situation in those countries, and it is not just Ebola but other deadly pathogens, and we are working very closely with our counterparts around the world.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: So, we have baseline measures for early detection and management already through electronic health declarations when travellers enter Singapore, and we have also made sure that our healthcare professionals and our healthcare system are always on the look-out and monitoring any of these trends that we spot.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: We will adjust these baseline measures if the situation changes.
